import sys

MOD = 998244353
INV2 = 499122177

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().decode('utf-8').strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n, m, l, r = map(int, data[:4])
    total_cells = n * m
    if total_cells & 1:
        print(pow(r - l + 1, total_cells, MOD))
        return
    even = r // 2 - (l - 1) // 2
    odd = (r - l + 1) - even
    ans = (pow(even + odd, total_cells, MOD) + pow(even - odd, total_cells, MOD)) % MOD
    ans = ans * INV2 % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
